title: Drift Wood #36 · Most Likely, again
logline: Senior superlatives, the real ones. He wins. The strip is drawn the normal size.

panels.composition: The gym. The senior awards. A PRINCIPAL at the mic. WOOD in the bleachers, mid-row this time.

balloons.text: ...Most Likely to Win a Pulitzer: Arthur Finch.

image.prompt: a high school gym awards assembly seen from the bleachers, a principal at a microphone under a CLASS OF 1999 banner, three teenagers in a middle row
image.notes: The principal says the real name. The strip's Wood is who stands up.

panels.composition: Wood standing. The overcoat. Applause drawn as small marks. He does not perform anything.

image.prompt: a gaunt teenage boy in an oversized overcoat standing up in the bleachers with no expression amid small applause marks

balloons.text: You were going to quote someone.

image.prompt: close-up of a teenage girl clapping and looking straight ahead while speaking sideways to someone

panels.composition: After. The gym empty. The certificate on the bleacher where he left it. The strip, wide and ordinary. Not drawn larger.
props: a certificate left on an empty bleacher

image.prompt: an empty high school gym after an assembly with a single certificate left lying on a bleacher, wide and quiet, black and white, no words

notes: Last year the strip grew for a ballot. This year it wins and stays the same size.
